entries.topic: Test: slow planets set the trend, fast planets the sudden moves
entries.analysis: Event study 2000-2026 on gold and silver (astronomy-layer events grouped by planet speed: move size and sudden >2-sigma days after each event) plus the 26-year rule results pooled by the speed of the planets each rule names. Sources of the idea: Kindle Ch.3/Ch.6, TA p.59-60, KD p.82/p.129.
entries.result: Not supported: fast-planet events brought no bigger or more sudden moves (ratios x0.95-1.10, none significant); slow-planet-only rules gold 57% vs 52% base (35 cases), silver 46% vs 52%. Opposite hint: sudden gold days within 3 days of Jupiter/Saturn/Rahu sign changes 23% vs 15% (p~0.03); Jupiter/Saturn stations calmer (9% vs 15%).

entries.topic: Gold ±2% days 2000-2026: which planetary factors surround them (±3 days)
entries.analysis: 476 GC=F days with |close-to-close| >= 2% (20 Nov 2000 - 20 Nov 2026). 239 factors were tested: lunations, eclipses, stations, sign/nakshatra ingresses, combustion, conjunctions/oppositions within ±3 days; retrogrades, signs, Sun contacts, pair relations on the day; all active gold rules. Each factor's expected count comes from the same years; Poisson p, Benjamini-Hochberg q, separate episodes counted. Out-of-sample: leads picked on 2000-2013 re-measured on 2013-2026.
entries.result: No factor significant after FDR (lowest q 0.36). Leads: Sun-Uranus opposition x2.13, Venus-Saturn conjunction x1.80, Saturn combustion begins x1.86, Jupiter nakshatra change x1.41, Rahu with Mars x1.44. Up: Mars in Capricorn x1.86 (62.5% up, p 0.003), Mars-Pluto conjunction x3.5. Down: Saturn combustion begins x2.3, Pluto R station x2.2, full Moon x1.24. The bullish rules Mars in Pushya (TA) and Sun in Libra with malefics (doc26) coincided with big falls. Out of sample: 14 of 23 early leads stayed above 1 but pooled x1.02 (p 0.34), no edge.

entries.topic: Venus rising in the West and the 30 Jan 2026 gold crash; TA Section 18 Venus rules 2000-2026

Gold -10.8% on 30 Jan, the session before the layer's date, then +6.1% on 3 Feb and +11.9% after 20 sessions. Leads: combust in East gold 12/16 (75% vs 57%, p 0.11); rises in East gold 40 sessions 13/15 (87% vs 63%, p 0.045). Combust in West did not hold up (7/16). entries.topic: Narrowing the outlook windows with fast planets (Moon, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars)
entries.analysis: 44 fast factors on the day (Moon relations to slow planets, Saturn 12th/2nd/6-8, malefic Moon, Moon sign change, lunation days, Mercury/Venus/Sun/Mars ingresses, stations, combustion ±1 day, KD Sun-Mercury conjunction and Mercury manifestation) tested on 2,498 historical watch-window days 2000-2026: same-year expected counts, Poisson p, BH q, both halves, lift outside windows, and a 100-run permutation (returns shuffled within year). Applied to every weekday of the forward watch items.
entries.result: Not supported beyond chance: 3 factors passed against 2.0 expected under permutation (90th pct 4); none survives FDR. Moon opposite the Sun x1.49 (only inside windows; outside x0.74), Moon 6/8 Saturn x1.31, Moon opposite Rahu x1.34; none picks a direction. Narrowed days, best guesses: 22 Jan, 22-23 Mar, 19-20 Jul, 30 Aug, 6-7 Sep, 25-26 Nov 2027; no trigger in 4-10 May, 22-28 Jun, 18 Oct, 1-7 Nov, 27-31 Dec.

entries.topic: Backtest of the signal table's High / Moderate / Low
entries.analysis: Table scoring applied to every trading day 2000-2026; runs of days with the same signal and strength scored like rules (entry = last close before; 3+ sessions to last close, else 5 sessions; same-year base; binomial p). Three runs: walk-forward (leads and fast triggers re-picked on 2000-2013, scored on 2013-2026), source rules only, in-sample.
entries.result: Walk-forward: Bullish High 64% vs 53% (33, p 0.16), Moderate 58% vs 54%, Low 54% vs 55%; High+Moderate 60% vs 54% (102, p 0.13). Bearish Moderate 48% vs 44%, Low 44% vs 44%; Volatile big-day 11 vs 10.4. Source rules only: bullish High+Moderate 67% vs 56% (57, p 0.058). Bullish strength order holds in every run but is not significant; bearish and volatile labels have no edge. A past-record column was added to the table.

Fast triggers: 3 of 44 passed vs 2.5 by chance. Table walk-forward: High = Moderate = Low = 55% vs 52%, no strength order; volatile 8 vs 13.7. Source rules only: bullish High 66% vs 53% (p 0.065), High+Moderate 60% vs 54% (p 0.075). The value is in retrograde Mercury or Jupiter: mid-Dec 2026 - mid-Apr 2027, 10 Jun - 2 Jul, 7-28 Oct 2027.

entries.topic: Stock market: S&P 500 and BSE Sensex, 26 years - document rules and ±2% days
entries.analysis: All ~628 computable general-market rules (TA, KD, 2026 document) detected 2000-2026 (161,252 events) and scored on the S&P 500 and the Sensex in each exchange's own time (same method as gold; FDR; walk-forward). The ±2% days of each index compared with the sky ±3 days (239+ factors incl. every rule; same-year expected counts; FDR; split halves; robustness without the 2008-09 and 2020 crashes). Robust factors' dates to end-2027.
entries.result: Direction: no edge (pooled 51.2 vs 51.1% S&P, 50.9 vs 50.9% Sensex; 9 rules p<0.05 vs ~18 by chance; none passes FDR; walk-forward 62 vs 61%, 58 vs 57%). Big days: robust volatility factors pass FDR - Venus retrograde in both markets (S&P x1.75, x1.92 without crashes; Sensex x1.61), S&P Jupiter-Pluto 5/9 x1.56, Jupiter-Neptune opposition x1.63, Jupiter-Uranus 6/8 x1.42, Mercury-Saturn 2/12 x1.38; Sensex Mars-Saturn conjunction x1.56, Venus in Pisces x1.44, Mars-Uranus 5/9 x1.31. Both directions. Out of sample Sensex x1.09 (p 0.0008), S&P x1.03. Venus retrograde does not occur before 2028.

entries.topic: Outside model check: crash table 1929-2028 and cross-asset roadmap 2026-2029 (two infographics)
entries.analysis: Every stated placement checked with our ephemeris at the crash date and across the crash window (45 historical, 23 forward); India 1947 Vimshottari periods computed; the 'core recurring signatures' defined objectively and tested on the S&P 500 1928-2026 (presence, crash hits, chance in a random 12-month window, 6-month 15%+ falls present vs absent); their 2026-2029 windows compared with our gold/silver/S&P/Sensex tables and robust big-move factors; prices to 20 Nov 2026.

Signatures do not predict crashes: Jupiter weakness, Mars trigger and eclipse/stellium are in every 12-month window since 1928 with no effect; Saturn-node / Pisces-Aries a weak hint (19.6 vs 14.2%). Agreement on turbulence timing (our robust factors cluster Feb-May 2027 and Jan-Jun 2028), not on direction (our S&P mixed, Sensex bullish-leaning Aug-Dec 2027); agree on silver strength Dec 2026-Jun 2027 and gold Aug 2027. Nov 2026 Act I numbers match prices but were drawn after the fact.
